coach_says: This is a dedicated recovery week. You've just absorbed a 700 km / 8000 m bikepacking block that Garmin badly undercounted — your positive TSB and UNBALANCED HRV confirm the numbers can't be trusted at face value, so the override drove every decision: Tuesday's hills ride and hard MTB group ride are cancelled, Friday and Saturday are full conference rest, and there are zero quality sessions. The aerobic-high shortage is real but gets addressed next week once HRV normalises — watch for HRV returning to balanced and morning legs feeling springy by the weekend before we reload.

days.details: Total 60 min | Primary objective: flush the legs after the bikepacking block | Zone 1, RPE 2-3. Flat route, high cadence (90-100 rpm), conversational the entire time. No intervals, no hills, no chasing anyone. Take advantage of the dry, mild conditions — this is the best outdoor day until the weekend. If legs feel wrecked, cut to 40 min without guilt.

NOTE: the usual Tuesday hills ride and evening MTB group ride are cancelled this week per the recovery override — weather is wet and windy anyway. Warmup: 200m easy mixed strokes. Main set: 4x100m freestyle at relaxed aerobic effort (RPE 3-4), 30s rest between reps; 4x50m drill focus (catch-up or single-arm), 20s rest. Cooldown: 100m very easy backstroke/breaststroke. Total: 900m. Non-weight-bearing, spine-friendly recovery after a week hunched on a loaded bike.

Indoor session on the wet, windy day. 35 min restorative flow targeting the bikepacking posture: hip flexor openers (low lunge, couch stretch 2 min/side), thoracic extension over a foam roller, pigeon pose 2 min/side, hamstring floss, finish with 5 min legs-up-the-wall and slow nasal breathing. Objective: parasympathetic recovery and undoing 7 days of flexed-hip riding position. No strength work, no load.

Warm-up: 8 min — bike erg easy spin 5 min, then glute bridges 2x10, band lateral walks 2x10/side. Main: Romanian Deadlift 3x8 (light, ~50-60% of usual working weight, focus on hinge quality), Bulgarian Split Squat 2x8/leg (bodyweight or light dumbbells), Single-Leg Glute Bridge 2x10/leg, Side Plank 2x30s/side, Bird Dog 2x8/side, Dead Bug 2x10/side. Rest 90s between sets, nothing to failure. Objective: deload session — maintain movement patterns and hip stability without adding fatigue during the recovery week. No heavy loading; Friday is full rest so no ride conflict.
Conference day, no training per the override. This lands perfectly in a recovery week. Prioritise walking between sessions, hydration, and getting to bed at a normal hour despite the social schedule.

Second conference day, full rest per the override. Two consecutive rest days at the end of a recovery week is exactly what this block needs — expect HRV and legs to bounce back noticeably by Sunday morning.

Total 105 min | Primary objective: reintroduce aerobic volume after two rest days without breaking the recovery week | Zone 2, RPE 3-4. Dry but breezy — head out into the wind, ride home with it. Steady conversational pace throughout, cadence 85-95 rpm, no surges on climbs. Optional: if HRV is back to balanced and legs feel genuinely fresh, add 2x8 min at upper Zone 2 / low Zone 3 with 5 min easy between as a gentle primer for next week's return to tempo/threshold work — which is where we'll attack the aerobic-high shortage properly.
